bibl.title: Two Early Ptolemaic Documents from Pathyris.
bibl.seg: 141.12 P. Lond. Inv. EA 10486 145.12 P. Ryl. Dem. 32
Marie-Pierre Chaufray & Wolfgang Wegner, Two Early Ptolemaic Documents from Pathyris.

Sandra L. Lippert, Maren Schentuleit & Martin A. Stadler (edd.), avec la collaboration de Till Dävel, Sapientia Felicitas. Festschrift für Günter Vittmann zum 29. Februar 2016 = CENiM. 14 (Montpellier, 2016) pp. 23-49, figg.
bibl.note: 1. P. BM EA (= P. Lond. Inv. EA) 10486. Offer to Lease the Job of Document(?)-Scribe of Pathyris. Pathyris, Sept. 27th, 204 BC. - 2. P. Ryl. Dem. 32. Transfer of a Plot Belonging to the Temple of Hathor. Nov. 12th - Dec. 11th, 204 BC. - 3. Historical Commentary: Dating [beginning of the Theban revolt]; - Scribe and scribal functions in the temple; - Priesthood of Pathyris; - Temple administration.
